newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Amcor says issue not tied to expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Amcor says issue not tied to expansion.

text.p: Paper and packaging group Amcor Ltd said on Thursday its move to raise another US$30 million in convertible notes was not linked to any planned acquisition.
"This extra US$30 million will just go into the general pool of funds to do with as we wish in the future," Amcor spokesman Peter Cairns told Reuters.
"We are not planning an acquisition, there's not anything in particular this money is earmarked for," he added.
The new funds are being raised on the same terms as a US$200 million issue announced in November and underwritten by merchant banks Merrill Lynch as lead-manager and Morgan Stanley.
Under the earlier issue of subordinated, perpetual convertible notes, the underwriters had an option to raise the additional US$30 million, Cairns said.
Amcor raised the initial US$200 million to refinance debt.
